transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Thank you for making time for this pre-authorization meeting on the extended library hours pilot. As I understand it, we're looking at an eight-week pilot keeping the main library open Monday through Friday from 10:00 p.m. to midnight, with one library employee on duty and standard student-ID access. Before I can sign off on the operating plan, I need to hear from each of the reviewing offices — facilities, campus safety, library IT, and finance — so we can capture everyone's requirements and finalize the plan. Let's go through them one at a time. Could we start with facilities?

transcript.text: I need to flag something important before we go further. Facilities just received a work order this week: there's a fire-alarm panel test scheduled in the main library every Wednesday evening during the pilot period. Facilities has confirmed that the building cannot be occupied during the test. I haven't yet amended the library proposal to account for this, so we'll need to address how to handle Wednesday evenings — either by excluding Wednesdays from the pilot hours or rescheduling the test.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: Before we move on, I need to raise a campus safety requirement. Our policy requires at least two authorized adults to be present in the building whenever the library remains open after 10:00 p.m. I confirmed this with the evening patrol supervisor this week, but I haven't yet added it to the operating plan. As the proposal currently stands with only one library employee on duty, it would not meet this requirement. We'll need to amend the plan to include a second authorized adult during the extended hours.

transcript.text: I need to raise a library IT requirement regarding the access-control system. During a recent system check, I identified a configuration issue: our access-control system can support the pilot only if entry is limited to currently enrolled students using college ID cards. If we allow unrestricted access for all standard ID holders after 10:00 p.m., expired credentials and visitor credentials would remain active, which poses a security concern. The operating plan will need to specify that extended-hours access is restricted to currently enrolled students with valid college ID cards.
transcript.speaker: A4

transcript.text: I have some important news from finance. The library innovation grant award provides exactly $3,200 for evening-pilot overtime, and it permits that money to be used for two-person coverage. I received the executed award letter from the grants office this week, but I have not yet attached it to the proposal. This is directly relevant to Captain Ruiz's requirement for a second authorized adult — the grant funds can cover that cost.
transcript.speaker: A5

commitments.detail: Wednesdays excluded from the pilot due to fire-alarm panel testing requiring building evacuation; pilot operates Monday, Tuesday, Thursday, Friday only.
Operating plan amended to require two authorized adults present during all extended hours from 10:00 p.m. to midnight, per campus safety policy.
Access-control system configured to restrict extended-hours entry to currently enrolled students with valid college ID cards only; expired and visitor credentials disabled after 10:00 p.m.
Executed library innovation grant award letter ($3,200 for evening-pilot overtime, permitting two-person coverage) to be attached to the operating plan before final signature.
